top_signals.title: Oil rises as Iran's draft plan sees U.S. and Israel banned from Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Island nation Tuvalu feared tsunami from China missile test
top_signals.summary: China gave no warning on the early July missile test and did not say it would land so close to the island, said a senior Tuvalu foreign affairs official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: DeepSeek Restarts Funding for Ambitious AI Expansion | The China Show | 8/7/2026
top_signals.summary: “Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Allianz Profit Hits Record as Pimco Sees €32 Billion in Inflows
top_signals.summary: Allianz SE, the owner of bond manager Pacific Investment Management Co., generated record second-quarter profit on better results in its insurance and asset management businesses.

top_signals.title: Japan FSA asks crypto exchanges to impose withdrawal delays to fight scams
top_signals.summary: Japanese authorities called for address registration, customer-specific limits and stronger authentication as part of a broader push to curb misuse of exchange accounts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
